projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for PHP
description: Composer packages. For the cloud, new DeviceDetectionPipelineBuilder(['resourceKey' => $key])->build(), then $data = $pipeline->createFlowData(), $data->evidence->setArray($evidence), $data->process(), and $data->device. On-premise uses the FiftyOneDegreesHashEngine extension (phpize) with FiftyOneDegreesHashEngine.data_file in php.ini. IpIntelligencePipelineBuilder is for IP Intelligence. FodId and DidClient read 51Did. Install with composer require 51degrees/fiftyone.devicedetection
